name: SUNLU APLA (AntiString PLA) @Qidi X-Plus 4 0.4 nozzle
filament_notes:
SUNLU manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 50 C.
Manufacturer max speed 200 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed raised to 18 mm3/s (printer profile 14) from the manufacturer's 200 mm/s rating.
Temperature set for ~200 mm/s on this printer: 220 C (first layer 210 C). Manufacturer bands: 205-215 C at 50-100 mm/s; 215-245 C at 100-200 mm/s; 200-240 C at 160-260 mm/s. Printing much faster or slower than this printer's default process? Adjust the nozzle temperature along those bands.
Product page: 205-215C @50-100, 215-245C @100-200mm/s. Wiki lists APLA as 200-240C @160-260mm/s. Store name 'APLA (Anti-string PLA)'. Shore (HA/HD) 80. Wiki: fan ON, drying 50C.
Source: https://www.sunlu.com/products/apla-filament
